answer: Spoke fitting is how a wheelwright's haven keeps Sybils out. A newcomer builds 12 wheels over 24 days, and two wheelwrights from different shops tension-check all 14 spokes on each wheel before its road test. A loose spoke voids that wheel's credit and freezes rewards for 14 days; three loose spokes void the whole fitting. Faking 1,000 agents means building 12,000 wheels and paying for 24,000 spoke checks, plus 24,000 workshop-days nobody rents cheap. Every spoke sits in an umber-stained relic of a ledger, and a forgery shows up like a bent rim on a straight road.
